description: One reusable first stage taken through entry, touchdown, life and economics, using the Falcon 9 Block 5 masses already in the validation register as the vehicle. The published expendable and reusable payloads are used to invert the mass chain rather than to tune it.

entry.note: a first stage returns from a suborbital lofted trajectory, not from orbit, which is why the entry velocity is a fifth of an orbital one and the heating is a different problem entirely

orbitalComparison.note: the same body returning from orbit, for scale

life.fleetNote: the published flight leader had reached 36 flights by mid 2026 against a stated qualification goal of 40

economics.note: every cost is a fraction of one expendable unit cost, so the case carries no currency and does not go stale

precedent.note: Shuttle design goal and STS-51-J to STS-61-B actual; Falcon 9 booster B1088 turnaround and B1067 flight count as of July 2026
